source: Among its provisions was a five-year requirement of continuous residence before receiving the title to the land

selectedIdea.title: When a land claim turned into ownership
selectedIdea.description: When a land claim turned into ownership
selectedIdea.rationale: When a land claim turned into ownership
selectedIdea.evidence: Among its provisions was a five-year requirement of continuous residence before receiving the title to the land

narrative:
### Selected Story
The story is about the link between making a land claim and receiving ownership title. A provision required five years of continuous residence before the claimant could receive title, making residence a condition of the path from claim to ownership. The reader should understand that a claim alone did not immediately confer title under this provision.

### Story Progression
- **Context:** Introduce the subject as a land claim that could lead to ownership title.
- **Development:** Explain the key provision: the claimant had to reside on the land continuously for five years before receiving title.
- **Endpoint:** Clarify that the provision made ownership title contingent on meeting that residence requirement.

### Critical Constraints
- Do not imply that a claimant completed the five-year requirement or received title.

selectedIdea.description: The unit that determines deposit coverage
selectedIdea.rationale: The unit that determines deposit coverage
selectedIdea.evidence: The standard deposit insurance amount is $250,000 per depositor, per FDIC-insured bank, per ownership category.

narrative:
### Selected Story
The story explains how the standard $250,000 FDIC deposit insurance amount is defined: by depositor, FDIC-insured bank, and ownership category. The reader should understand that all three are part of the stated basis for deposit coverage.

### Story Progression
- **Context:** Introduce the standard deposit insurance amount: $250,000.
- **Development:** Explain the three units named in the coverage rule: the depositor, the FDIC-insured bank, and the ownership category.
- **Endpoint:** Clarify that the standard amount is specified across those three units.

### Critical Constraints
- Describe this as the standard deposit insurance amount; do not imply that the inputs establish other coverage amounts or rules.

- **Development:** Explain the supported relationship: readers must wait until writing has finished.
- **Endpoint:** Clarify that readers wait until writes finish, which is the central point about who has to wait.
